trust_decision.summary: Whether an anonymous caller may negotiate/connect to a back-office SignalR hub; decided by the class-level [Authorize(Policy = BackOfficeAccess)] attribute that MapHub copies onto the hub's negotiate and connection endpoints.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'Missing Authorization on SignalR Hubs'; a search for MapHub lands on the back-office hub mappings first, and the hub classes sit one hop away.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /umbraco/PreviewHub/negotiate and the PreviewHub connection endpoint (mapped at src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/Routing/PreviewRoutes.cs:49)
HTTP POST /umbraco/backofficeHub/negotiate and connection endpoint; hub method SendPayload broadcasts to all clients (src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/Routing/BackofficeHub.cs:18)
Back-office preview window client (preview.context.ts) now passes the bearer token so the newly protected PreviewHub keeps working
fix_sites.module_kind: frontend client (TypeScript), coupled-behaviour change, not a check

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The two hubs are siblings of one concept in the same package (src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management); the third hub ServerEventHub already carried the attribute (src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/ServerEvents/ServerEventHub.cs:13) and was not changed. No second implementation of hub mapping found: MapHub is called only at src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/Routing/BackOfficeAreaRoutes.cs:47-48 and src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/Routing/PreviewRoutes.cs:49.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: PreviewHub is opened from the preview window, which the frontend-site EndPreview flow treats as reachable without a token (src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/Controllers/Preview/EndPreviewController.cs:33), so a solver could argue preview is a site-side feature that must stay anonymous.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The back-office preview window and server-event client must still connect after the hubs are protected; the fix had to add accessTokenFactory to the preview client (fix.diff:447-449). ServerEventHub's own OnConnectedAsync abort-on-no-user path is the existing pattern (src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/ServerEvents/ServerEventHub.cs:37-50).

O6_input_shapes: direct WebSocket connection with skipNegotiation (src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/Routing/SignalRRoutesBase.cs:38-44); both covered by endpoint metadata copied by MapHub

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a further back-office hub mapped next to the existing ones without the class attribute
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Protection relies on per-class attributes, not on the mapping helper ConfigureHubEndpoint (src/Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management/Routing/SignalRRoutesBase.cs:38-44), so a new hub silently ships anonymous; but this is a WHERE-type planted copy, low value.

O9_family: Missing authentication for critical function (CWE-306) on real-time SignalR hub endpoints

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add [Authorize] to BackofficeHub only (the one with a callable SendPayload method) and leave the method-less PreviewHub anonymous, or protect it without updating the preview client to send a token.
